hero.headline: Empowering teenagers. Honouring the elderly.
hero.subheadline: Bridging two generations — through mentorship, healthcare, and community outreach across Nigeria and the UK since 2016.

paragraphs: Somewhere in the corner of the world, a teenage girl is deciding whether she believes in her own future.
A few streets away, an elderly woman is spending another day alone — unseen, unheard, uncared for.
They are both the reason we exist.
PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION exists to close the distance between these two lives — to guide one, and to honour the other.

about.label: Who We Are
about.title: About PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION
paragraphs: Founded in 2016 by Tosin AKANO, PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION is a non-governmental organisation committed to building stronger communities by empowering teenagers and caring for elderly people.

What began as a vision to mentor young people has grown into a movement of hope that now reaches families and communities across Nigeria and the United Kingdom — through education, advocacy, humanitarian outreach, and compassionate service.
We believe that honouring the elderly is not charity — it is a moral obligation. And that guiding a young person today shapes the world for decades to come.

youth.title: Youth & Teenagers
youth.description: Teenagers today carry a future the world hasn't seen yet. We help them see it too — through mentorship, self-esteem programs, and life skills that build character and confidence.

elderly.title: Elderly People
elderly.description: Many elderly Nigerians spend their final years without care, companionship, or proper healthcare. We bring medicine, food, and dignity back into their lives.

scripture.text: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress.

featuredStory.label: Impact
featuredStory.pullQuote: I thank God and PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION for restoring my hope.
featuredStory.name: Mrs. Lawal Abeke
featuredStory.story: Mrs. Lawal Abeke was living with severe cataracts that took her independence. Through our medical outreach, she received a full eye examination, cataract surgery, and prescription glasses. She can see her grandchildren again.

theNeed.label: Why We Exist
theNeed.title: The Need Is Urgent
theNeed.line: By 2050, 2.1 billion people will be over 60 — and 80% of them will live in countries least equipped to care for them.
theNeed.interpretation: That's not a distant statistic. That's a mother, a father, a grandparent — someone's whole world.

founder.name: Tosin AKANO
founder.bio: In 2016, Tosin AKANO founded PHINEHAS GENERATION with a conviction: that every young person deserves guidance, and every elderly person deserves to be valued. Eight years later, that conviction still shapes every program we run.
founder.quote: Raising tomorrow's leaders while honouring yesterday's heroes.

items.quote: Attending the PHINEHAS GENERATION youth conference changed the way I viewed my future. Today, I am a university graduate, and I remain grateful.
items.author: Deborah A.

items.quote: Volunteering here has shown me the true meaning of service. Watching young people grow — and seeing smiles return to elderly faces — has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my life.
